Full skill text at 5★
Deals (200% of Fire Qilin's ATK + 50000) DMG to all enemies, with a 45% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn (the inflicted effect has 180% extra Effect Hit). Afterward, increases Fire Qilin's DMG dealt by 12% and allied heroes' Crit DMG dealt by 12% till the end of the battle, stackable up to 10 layers.
Source: game files.

How to obtain

  • Spirit Beast Cultivation — limited-time event; full cultivation progress grants 10 Souls of this Spirit Beast.
  • Purgatory of Seven Sins — first-clear reward, Difficulty 45 (5 Souls)
  • Random Spirit Beast Shard — Soul drop chance: 1.57%
  • Hire Store — can be hired temporarily (not kept).
